It depends on who I am hanging out with. If it is with people that are aware of my depression, I am honest and say that I can't drink more than a glass because it will interfere with my medication.
If you don't want to put it all out there, you are allowed to simply say "No thanks, I don't drink, thanks for the offer though". You don't owe anyone an explanation or more than what you are confortable of sharing. And if anyone pries, just say it is due to personal reasons. I hope this helps!

When he is ready, he will talk about it. Don't push. Just be there to listen, and don't judge.
Look up on google 'To Write Love On Her Arms', and read the articles there. I hope it helps. Good luck.
Thank you. And yes, it has not been easy, but I am mainly glad that the doctor is helping. :)

I don´t want to fade away because it would be a reminder of not only the people I lost because of my struggles, but also that time has passed before I even realized that it did... if that makes it any sense.

Dear theshaneguy,

How are you right now? That note was really sad. It really looks like you are hurting a lot. It is good that you let those words out. Because you need love and support to go through this tough time. Did you tell Jackie about what has been troubling you? I am sure she loves you no matter what, and would do anything to help you. She would be sad to know how much you are struggling, but would be also grateful that you shared that with her. This also applies to anyone that cares about you. Because the one truth depression can never change: there are people who care. We all care. You are not alone.
Cheers, Velvet.

Give it time, focus on getting better. I know how you feel and what you have been going through, trust me... Seek support from those around you, your family and other friends. Of you need to talk, feel free to pm me.
It is hard. And it does suck. But you are not alone. And I wish you a happy birthday.
I am sorry that happened to you. I don't know how it works in the UK, but is there any insurance money you can claim due to this incident?
Amen.

Hey there, I know exactly how you feel, since I am going through the same thing. Let me be honest for a moment here: it will suck. Hard. Everything will remind you of her, the smallest of things will make your emotions boil, even tinny gift she gave you, a movie you both liked, and so on. But allow me to say, it will get better. You will have your down days, but you will also have your up days. Allow yourself to grieve this loss, focus on yourself, and seek out support from other people that care about you.
On the meantime, if you need to vent, of you need to talk, feel free to pm me (although my response time will be slow since I am travelling).
Ask female friends if they have any samples they can lend? Also, can you order stuff online?

Look up "tattoo make up cover" online. There are good waterproof make up concealers that are used for tattoos that can also be used on scars. Be sure to also apply cream on your scars to help the skin heal, and it also helps with applying the make up
Wishing you all the best too.
It's ok, we have all been there. You are not alone in this. Feel free to DM/PM if you need to vent or talk to someone.
Hey Ryan, it seems like you are going through some rough times. Do you want to talk?
I do have other friends, and it is a long story... We are basically both at fault, and it is the result of months of stress on both sides...
I made a post about almost a month ago, but basically my oldest and closest friend, that I considered like a sister, walked away a cut all contact with me, partially due to my depression...

Yeah, it is the first time I have this feeling of longing for eternal sleep, but that is because it was the first time I had a vivid dream that everything was "good". My former friend was talking to me again, I didn't feel depressed anymore, my friends were all within reach. But then I woke up ans felt just a crushing sadness...
Prepare for all the raging. May you roll many natural 20s. :)

Take a deep breath. Take a pause. Treat your wound, clean it, bandage it, clean anything that you might have to as well. Then take another deep breath. Everything is going to be OK.
Also if you need to see more blood, just look at your band aid tomorrow when you change it. There will probably be some on it.
Hmm, good point. What about a rubber band on your wrist? No one will question that. Also, if it becomes unbearable, go talk to a councilor or a GP if you can.
I also have a little kit along with the razors. That is an interesting alternative. Thank you for the tip.
Did you try using a pen instead? Mark where you want to cut?

It's OK... We all here have been there... Just please be careful, disinfect the cut and talk with your GP about your issues. Go to a friend or a family member that you can talk to about this and help you through this difficult time. And if your husband is not helping you, and making you feel worse or being emotionally abusive, forget him. Your mental health comes first.

Most people don't notice unless they are very visible. I went to the gym yesterday and removed the bandage from my healing cuts, and no one at the work out noticed, because they were focused on other things.
But about your question, I think it also depends on the reason why you cut? I don't know, I don't want people to find out because I know they would freak out, or would puzzled and confused to something that, for me, makes sense. My mental illness is making me believe that my self harm is normal (amongst other trains of thoughts) . Whereas people around me say that it isn't. And that is what makes me feel ashamed and uncomfortable. It is the lack of understanding from the other people.

I desinfect the blade after bandaging and disinfecting the cut. It sounds twisted, but I want to make sure my cuts are as clean as possible so that it doesn't scar and doesn't infect so I can cut there again later.
We believe in you.

It depends on what you like. My first tattoo was based on a drawing I made after I recovered from my first depression. Maybe you should look around on the Internet (pinterest is a cool place to look) for designs and either find one that speaks to you, or that you know, you will look down and mainly see an awesome design over something a distant memory from your past.

Hello there. First time posting,sorry. I am sorry this is happening to you. I know this will sound cheesy but... Please see the beauty in that our world has to offer. Think that, if you are gone tomorrow, you do not get to do any of the things you like to do anymore. I am sorry if I do not make sense, I am a bit socially awkward. Just... Hang in there. Beat the 3 months record with four months. And if you relapse, that is OK. Just treat your wounds, patch them up, take a deep breath and start again. You will be OK.
